name: Banks - Private

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: FINANCIALS - BANKS: Healthy growth outlook; NIM trends divergent; asset quality improves
mofsl_2qfy27.read: Systemic credit growth accelerated to 19.4% YoY in Sep'26 (10.5% a year ago) on surplus liquidity after ~USD133b of FCNR(B) mobilisation. Private bank NII grew 14.4% YoY and PAT 25.2% YoY (INR516.6b), but NIMs fell 10-22bp QoQ at KMB, AXSB, ICICIBC and HDFCB, and 55bp at EQUITASB, on FCNR(B) liquidity; RBK was the only private bank with NIM expansion. MOFSL expects private banks to deliver ~16.5% growth, with mid-sized lenders outperforming on NIM recovery, and flags the proposed insurance distribution changes (50-60% potential hit to insurance-related fee income) as a key monitorable.

unit_economics: RoA = NII/assets (NIM) + core fees/assets - opex/assets - credit cost/assets, taxed at ~25%; RoE = RoA x leverage (~8-10x); large banks fund growth from CASA, mid-sized banks pay 50-150bp more for deposits and price up into unsecured or MFI.

price_drivers.driver: NIM direction after the FCNR(B) inflow and the repo hike
price_drivers.why: Q2FY27 NIMs fell 10-22bp at KMB, AXSB, ICICIBC and HDFCB on surplus FCNR(B) liquidity; HDFCB guides expansion from 3QFY27, ICICIBC from 4QFY27, so the recovery timing sets the EPS path.

price_drivers.driver: Slippages and credit cost, especially unsecured, MFI and CV
price_drivers.why: MOFSL sees stress easing, but select agri portfolios and drought pockets are weak; credit cost guidance (AUBANK ~90bp, KMB improving) decides whether RoA holds.

price_drivers.driver: Deposit franchise: CASA ex-FCNR, LDR and LCR
price_drivers.why: FCNR(B) deposits inflate deposits and dilute CASA; banks need ex-FCNR CASA and LDR back inside their bands to fund 16-25% loan growth without paying up.
MOFSL cites a potential 50-60% hit to insurance-related fee income; bancassurance is ~7% of private bank PBT on broker estimates and higher at Axis and Yes.

price_drivers.driver: Rate cycle and cost of equity
price_drivers.why: A repo hike lifts NII on EBLR loans but raises the risk-free rate used in P/B multiples; brokers cut target multiples while raising NIM estimates.

kpis.name: NIM (ex tax-refund interest, ex-FCNR)
kpis.definition: Net interest income over average interest-earning assets, stated on the bank's own basis and stripped of income-tax-refund interest and the FCNR(B) liquidity drag.
kpis.formula: (NII - tax-refund interest) / average interest-earning assets, annualised; also quote domestic and ex-FCNR NIM
kpis.why_it_moves_price: NII is 70%+ of bank revenue and opex is sticky, so 10bp of NIM is roughly 3-5% of PPOP. Q2FY27 showed KMB, AXSB, ICICIBC, HDFCB down 10-22bp and Equitas down 55bp; the market prices the recovery date.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'NIM' (company basis, quarterly); get_financials for NII and average assets to rebuild a house NIM; Motilal Oswal results tables in the report library (list_library_documents, doc_type broker, Motilal Oswal) for a uniform quarterly series.
kpis.estimate_source: No Bloomberg consensus field for NIM: use broker models (Motilal Oswal, Kotak IE, IIFL results notes) and management NIM guidance from transcripts (search_research / get_qa). get_consensus_estimates only gives PAT, EPS and BVPS, which embed the NIM view.
kpis.traps: HDFC Bank quotes NIM on total assets in its deck and on interest-earning assets elsewhere; ICICI changed its day-count annualisation in Q1FY26; Q4 NIM is flattered by day count at Kotak; IDFC First quotes on an AUM basis; tax-refund interest and FCNR(B) mix distort single quarters.

kpis.name: Gross slippage ratio
kpis.definition: Fresh NPA additions in the quarter as a share of opening gross advances, annualised, split by segment where disclosed.
kpis.formula: Gross slippages x 4 / opening gross advances
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Slippage leads credit cost by one to two quarters and is the early read on unsecured, MFI and agri stress; GNPA alone falls through write-offs even when slippage rises.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'slippages' (deck NPA roll-forward); get_financials for GNPA and advances to rebuild the roll-forward; Motilal Oswal results tables for a comparable series.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus for slippages: use broker models (Motilal Oswal asset quality tables), management guidance on credit cost and slippage from transcripts, and the house roll-forward.
kpis.traps: Write-offs (35-89% of opening GNPA across large banks) mask rising slippage; technical write-offs; seasonal KCC/agri slippage in Q1 and Q3; some banks report net slippage only.

kpis.name: Credit cost (house basis)
kpis.definition: Specific and standard-asset provisions, net of recoveries from written-off accounts, over average advances; buffer builds, treasury and one-offs excluded.
kpis.formula: (specific NPA + NFB-NPA + standard provisions - TWO recoveries) / average advances, annualised
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Credit cost is the largest swing item below PPOP: 25bp of credit cost is 10-15% of PBT at a 1.5% RoA bank, and mid-sized lenders (AUBANK ~90bp guidance, RBL, IIB) carry the most leverage to it.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (provisions and contingencies, advances); get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'credit cost' for the company's own basis; Motilal Oswal results tables.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models (Motilal Oswal, Kotak IE) and company credit-cost guidance from transcripts; no Bloomberg consensus field. Treat management guidance as a ceiling for large banks, as ICICI has come in below its guide in most quarters.
kpis.traps: ICICI reports credit cost net of recoveries and write-backs; Kotak shows specific provisions only; RBL quotes quarterly not annualised; HDFC books recoveries in other income; discretionary buffer builds and releases move reported provisions.

kpis.name: CASA ratio and deposit growth ex-FCNR
kpis.definition: Current and savings deposits over total deposits after removing FCNR(B) balances; shown with LDR and LCR.
kpis.formula: (CA + SA) / (total deposits - FCNR(B)); period-end and quarterly average both stated
kpis.why_it_moves_price: CASA sets cost of funds and the sustainable loan growth rate; MOFSL notes FCNR(B) mobilisation was highest at ICICIBC, RBK and IDFCFB relative to their deposit base, so ex-FCNR numbers show who is actually gaining deposits.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'CASA' (period-end and average); get_financials for deposit schedules; company business-update filings via search_research.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; use broker models (Motilal Oswal, Nomura, Kotak IE) and management deposit and LDR commentary from transcripts.
kpis.traps: HDFC, Axis and Kotak quote averages, IIB, IDFC, RBL, Bandhan period-end; FCNR(B) distorts CASA, LDR and NIM from Q2FY27; ex-FCNR definitions differ by broker.

kpis.name: Loan growth (ex-FCNR, ex-inorganic)
kpis.definition: YoY gross advances after removing overseas and IBU loans funded by FCNR(B) deposits and any merger or IBPC effects.
kpis.formula: Reported gross advances growth with each exclusion named
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Systemic credit growth of 19.4% is partly FCNR-funded low-spread loans; domestic ex-FCNR growth shows share gains that earn full NIM.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (advances); get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'advances' or 'loan growth'; Motilal Oswal results tables.
kpis.estimate_source: Management growth guidance from transcripts (AUBANK ~25% FY27, RBK 22-25%); broker models for forward loans; consensus gives EPS and BVPS only.
kpis.traps: ICICI reports loans net of BRDS/IBPC; segment categories restated by Kotak and ICICI; FCNR-funded overseas loans carry ~1% NIM.

kpis.name: Core fees to assets and bancassurance share
kpis.definition: Retail, card, transaction-banking, distribution and PSLC fees over average assets, with bancassurance commission shown separately as a share of fees and PBT.
kpis.formula: Core fees / average assets; insurance commission / PBT
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Fees are 20-30% of revenue; MOFSL flags a potential 50-60% hit to insurance-related fee income from the proposed distribution changes, which is largest where bancassurance is a bigger share of PBT.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (other income breakdown); get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'fee income' or 'third-party distribution'; annual report via list_library_documents (doc_type annual_report) for commission by line.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models and regulatory-impact notes in the report library (Motilal Oswal, JM, Kotak); no consensus field. Management mitigation comments from transcripts.
kpis.traps: Trading gains and subsidiary dividends sit in other income; recoveries from written-off accounts booked in fees at HDFC; PSLC income is annual not quarterly.

kpis.name: Opex to average assets and cost-to-income
kpis.definition: Operating expenses over average total assets, with PSLC purchase premium shown separately.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Operating leverage is the main EPS lever for mid-sized banks (MOFSL expects them to outperform on improving operating leverage); large banks run 1.7-3.1%, high-yield mid banks 3.6-5.9%.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (operating expenses, total assets); get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'cost to income'.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models (Motilal Oswal, Kotak IE); management cost-to-income guidance from transcripts; no consensus field.
kpis.traps: FCNR inflates average assets in Q2FY27 and mechanically lowers the ratio; labour-code and one-off charges; fraud losses booked in opex.

kpis.name: CET1, provision buffers and ECL readiness
kpis.definition: Common equity tier 1 ratio ex interim profit, plus contingent and floating provision stock as a share of loans against the expected day-1 ECL shortfall from 1-Apr-2027.
kpis.formula: CET1 reported; buffer stock / gross advances; ECL shortfall = estimate - buffers
kpis.why_it_moves_price: ECL is a capital event and a recurring 10-15bp credit cost; banks with thin buffers (IIB, RBL, Bandhan per brokers) may need equity, which dilutes book value.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'CET1' and 'CRAR'; get_financials for reserves; Pillar-3 and annual report through list_library_documents.
kpis.estimate_source: Management ECL commentary from transcripts and broker capital-adequacy notes; no consensus field.
kpis.traps: ICICI quotes CET1 including interim profits; buffers used once either against NNPA or ECL, not both; RBI-directed provisions with stated write-backs.

macro_inputs.source: RBI policy statements; Airavat transcripts for bank commentary
macro_inputs.why: EBLR-linked loans reprice within a quarter while deposits lag 2-4 quarters; the hike is the NIM recovery catalyst.

macro_inputs.series: RBI fortnightly credit and deposit growth
macro_inputs.source: RBI data; compare with company provisional business updates in Airavat transcripts and filings
macro_inputs.why: System denominator for market share; includes FCNR-driven overseas lending.

macro_inputs.source: Market data outside Airavat commodity tools
macro_inputs.why: Treasury MTM and the risk-free input to cost of equity and target P/B.

macro_inputs.series: FCNR(B) deposit stock and maturity ladder
macro_inputs.why: Drives CASA dilution, NIM trough in 3QFY27 and a 3-5 year refinancing cliff.

macro_inputs.series: CRIF bureau PAR for PL, cards and MFI
macro_inputs.source: Broker sector notes in the Airavat report library
macro_inputs.why: Leads unsecured slippages by one to two quarters.

valuation_anchor: P/B and P/ABV against RoE (justified P/B = (RoE - g)/(CoE - g)); large banks on core P/ABV with subsidiaries as a SOTP line (HDFCBANK, ICICIBANK, KOTAKBANK), mid-sized lenders on P/B against normalised RoA of 1.0-1.5%.
watch_next_quarter: MOFSL expects NIM recovery: HDFCB from 3QFY27 with the rate hike, RBK and ICICIBC from 4QFY27 after FCNR(B) deposits are deployed or replaced; watch ex-FCNR CASA, KMB's gradual deployment of surplus liquidity, credit cost against AUBANK's ~90bp FY27 guide, and the final insurance distribution rules.
